### Problem

Describe the use case and the current limitation.

### Proposed behavior

Explain the desired result. Include an example request or configuration if useful, with credentials removed.

### Upstream support

For a new endpoint, model, or parameter, link the relevant [MiniMax documentation](https://platform.minimax.io/docs) and note which region and credential type support it.

### Alternatives

Describe any workaround or alternative considered.
